plugins.name: tuteliq
plugins.description: Child-safety and fraud detection for text, voice, image and video. Bundles the Tuteliq MCP server plus workflow skills for grooming audits, incident moderation and compliance export.

skills.name: compliance-export
skills.description: Produce compliance evidence from Tuteliq. Export account data, pull audit logs and receipts, manage consent records, log and track breaches, and answer GDPR subject requests. Use when asked to prepare a KOSA, DSA, COPPA or GDPR evidence pack, respond to a data subject access or erasure request, or show an auditor what was detected and what was done about it.
skills.description_zh: 从Tuteliq整理合规证据：导出账户数据、审计日志与回执，管理同意记录、记录跟踪数据泄露，并处理数据主体访问或删除请求；支持原文所列KOSA、DSA、COPPA或GDPR证据包及审计说明。

skills.name: grooming-audit
skills.description: Audit a conversation for grooming risk using Tuteliq. Use when asked to review a chat log, DM thread, or message history for predatory behaviour toward a minor, to check whether an adult-to-child conversation is safe, or to assess grooming tactics across a conversation trajectory. Also covers bullying, self-harm and unsafe-content review of the same material.
headings: Auditing a conversation for grooming risk
skills.description_zh: 用Tuteliq审查聊天记录、私信或消息历史中的未成年人诱骗风险，评估成人与儿童对话及持续诱骗策略，同时审查同一材料中的霸凌、自伤和不安全内容。

skills.name: incident-review
skills.description: Work a Tuteliq moderation queue. Triage incidents, inspect detail, action them, and produce incident reports. Use when asked to review flagged content, clear a moderation backlog, check what needs attention, escalate or dismiss incidents, or generate a report for a specific incident or time period.
skills.description_zh: 处理Tuteliq内容审核队列：分流事件、查看详情、采取处置并生成报告；用于审核标记内容、清理积压、检查待关注项、升级或驳回事件及指定事件或期间报告。

headings: Tuteliq Plugin: Child Safety, Content Moderation and Fraud Detection MCP Server
